name: AnythingLLM
description: AnythingLLM is the easiest to use, all-in-one AI application that can do RAG, AI Agents, and much more with no code or infrastructure headaches.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  anythingllm:
    image: mintplexlabs/anythingllm
    container_name: anythingllm
    ports:
      - target: 3001
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    cap_add:
      - SYS_ADMIN
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/storage
        target: /app/server/storage
    environment:
      - STORAGE_DIR=/app/server/storage
    restart: always
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
